fields.build: strict recipe: add Gtk4.Forms.Wpf PackageReference, build (converts, exit 10), build again; pass = "Build succeeded" and "0 Error(s)" in the final log; not-built = legacy non-SDK csproj (built by this run as .NET Framework, see legacyBuild) or native project
fields.run: runs = alive with a visible top-level window (about 10 s smoke run, Windows); crash = unhandled exception or exit before a window; hang = alive, no window; skipped = library; not-run = did not build
fields.windowsOnly: verified classification carried over from the earlier runs (WinForms, Win32/HWND interop, UIA client, COM/ActiveX, WinRT, System.Speech, OLE DB, per-monitor DPI by design, native C++); unchanged in this run
fields.errorCodes: distinct error codes of the final build log (build2.log, <name>.build2.log or build.final.log), re-parsed uniformly for all six batches (a markup-compiler XAML parse error has no code and is listed under xamlErrors only)
fields.missingMembers: CS1061/CS0117 Type.Member and CS0103 names, re-parsed from the final log
fields.xamlErrors: errors located in generated *.g.cs files or in XAML (deduplicated by code and message, at most 12); includes real layer gaps surfaced through generated code, see the report for the classification
fields.blockerThemes: coarse regex classification of the final-build errors, used for the Next rounds ranking; a ranking aid, not an exact partition
fields.previous: the same project in report 2c67b72c (main 1b50a528, pinned)
fields.unblockedBy: the Round 47/48 change that removed the 2c67b72c blocker (attributed by elimination from the previous errors, not bisected)
fields.regression: investigated cause of a pass->fail or runs->crash/hang (none in this run)
fields.measured: false only for the 4 native C++ projects, which are not in this run's csproj inventory and are carried over
fields.note: measurement caveats for this row (windows-only disagreement, manual rebuild)
fields.legacyBuild: legacy csproj only: the .NET Framework build this run attempted (not a measurement of the layer)
fields.runCause: cause of a crash or hang, from the run's stderr and a check of the layer source
